_comment: Live trigger eval-set for using-agentic-sdlc (the router). Positives target the router's OWN trigger surface per its description: explicit AGENTIC-SDLC routing questions / 'which project skill owns this work' prompts. The router's child-routing ACCURACY (does a scope shift land on the right focused skill) is covered by the ROUTING eval at tests/skills/routing/using-agentic-sdlc.json, not here: asking the router to 'evaluate the scope shift and pick the next skill' makes the model route to that child skill, which structurally under-credits the router in a first-tool trigger eval. Note: the router is also SessionStart-bootstrapped, so on weaker models it may answer a routing question inline instead of re-invoking the Skill; treat low haiku numbers here as a model-capacity floor and rely on the routing eval for the router's real behavior. Negatives = clear focused prompts that go straight to another skill, not a routing question.
